Responsibility: Email/password/OTP/social login, account linking, session management, MFA policy and recovery.
Acceptance: OAuth login, logout, account-linking and AAL2-gated admin actions pass positive/negative tests.

Responsibility: Canonical profile, names, phone, locale, timezone, accessibility and travel preferences.
Acceptance: Profile updates are audited, validated and reflected across customer/host/guide views.

Responsibility: RBAC plus scoped entitlements for USER/HOST/GUIDE/SUPPLIER/ADMIN/ACCOUNTING/SUPPORT.
Acceptance: Server-side authorization denies every unauthorized API regardless of UI visibility.

Responsibility: Terms/privacy/marketing consent versioning, retention, export, deletion and restricted processing.
Acceptance: Consent evidence is versioned; deletion/export workflows are reproducible and auditable.

Responsibility: User identity, host/guide/supplier business and payout-account verification state.
Acceptance: Restricted actions remain blocked until required verification predicates are true.

Responsibility: Transaction-bound reviews, bilateral exchange reviews, guide reviews, host responses, moderation.
Acceptance: Only eligible completed transactions can create one review per review target/policy window.

Responsibility: Safety reports, evidence, disputes, case ownership, escalation, sanctions and audited access.
Acceptance: Cases retain immutable evidence hashes and sensitive message access requires audited elevation.

Responsibility: Host application, verification checklist, payout profile reference and host status.
Acceptance: Host cannot publish paid inventory until role, verification and compliance predicates are satisfied.

Responsibility: Property draft, address, geo, occupancy, amenities, house rules, rental/exchange switches and lifecycle.
Acceptance: Draft-to-publish flow validates required content and compliance gate before public visibility.

Responsibility: Presigned uploads, private staging, image/video metadata, transformation/moderation and CDN publication.
Acceptance: MIME/size/ownership validation and private-to-public promotion occur only after successful processing.

Responsibility: Permit types, jurisdiction rules, guest eligibility, expiry and publish/booking block decisions.
Acceptance: Paid booking cannot be enabled when required permit/eligibility checks are missing, expired or rejected.

Responsibility: Text/geo/facet search projection, ranking, filters, map viewport and date-aware candidate retrieval.
Acceptance: Search produces candidates but checkout revalidates authoritative availability in booking DB.

Responsibility: Saved properties, guides, trips and shareable collections.
Acceptance: Idempotent add/remove and privacy controls work across web/mobile PWA sessions.

Responsibility: Authoritative availability rules, host blocks, rate overrides, min stay and calendar projection.
Acceptance: Calendar reads and writes preserve no-overlap invariant across paid stay/exchange/host blocks.

Responsibility: Nightly/base price, fees, taxes as rules, promotions, quote expiry and price breakdown.
Acceptance: Quote is deterministic, currency-safe, itemized, time-bounded and immutable after booking confirmation.

Responsibility: Transactional hold acquisition, TTL expiry, idempotency and collision protection.
Acceptance: Concurrent hold tests prove capacity cannot be exceeded for overlapping dates.

Responsibility: DRAFT→QUOTED→HELD→PAYMENT_PENDING→CONFIRMED→CHECKED_IN→COMPLETED plus failure/cancel/refund branches.
Acceptance: Only enumerated transitions are accepted; all transitions store actor, reason and correlation id.

Responsibility: Cancellation policy evaluation, no-show, check-in/out and refund intent generation.
Acceptance: Policy calculation is tested at boundary dates and never mutates historical quote breakdown.

Responsibility: Exchange-enabled property eligibility, household preferences, legal classification and safety prerequisites.
Acceptance: No exchange request can enter agreement stage unless both sides satisfy configured legal/safety policy.

Responsibility: A↔B request, dates, property pair, terms, counter-offer version chain and withdrawal/decline.
Acceptance: Both parties see one canonical offer version; stale-version acceptance is rejected.

Responsibility: Mutual-acceptance verification checklist before contract generation.
Acceptance: Agreement generation is impossible until required identity/property checks are approved.

Responsibility: Versioned terms snapshot, deposit/damage policy, bilateral acceptance timestamps and evidence.
Acceptance: Both parties accept exactly the same terms_version; acceptance evidence cannot be overwritten.

Responsibility: Atomic calendar blocks on both properties and rollback if either block fails.
Acceptance: Confirmed exchange blocks both homes without colliding with paid reservations or host blocks.

Responsibility: In-progress/completed/disputed/reviewed lifecycle and bilateral review eligibility.
Acceptance: Completion unlocks reviews; dispute preserves evidence and blocks premature settlement/deposit release.

Responsibility: FRIEND/VOLUNTEER/PAID/PROFESSIONAL classification, bio, languages, areas, specialties, price and verification.
Acceptance: Paid/professional offerings are blocked until required business/qualification gates are satisfied.

Responsibility: Time windows, timezone-aware schedule, blackout and booking locks.
Acceptance: Overlapping confirmed guide bookings cannot exceed capacity and timezone conversions are deterministic.

Responsibility: Location, language, interest, type, price, trust, availability and response-time ranking.
Acceptance: Result candidates are filtered by eligibility and authoritative availability is rechecked before booking.

Responsibility: Traveler request, guide offer/counter, scope, duration, price or free confirmation.
Acceptance: Offer acceptance uses version checks; free and paid paths are explicit and never conflated.

Responsibility: Confirmed activity, payment dependency for paid types, start/complete/cancel/dispute.
Acceptance: Paid booking confirms only after server-verified payment; free booking confirms with no payment object.

Responsibility: Tours/tickets/activities/packages, supplier profile, options, terms and publish workflow.
Acceptance: Published product identifies seller/merchant role and has valid supplier/compliance status.

Responsibility: Departure dates, capacity, minimum participants, inventory allocations and cutoff rules.
Acceptance: Checkout cannot oversell departure capacity and minimum-participant status is explicit.

Responsibility: Day/activity itinerary, map points, attachments and customer-facing schedule.
Acceptance: Versioned itinerary edits preserve booked-customer snapshot when required.

Responsibility: Mixed travel-product order, line items, buyer, seller role, totals and cancellation linkage.
Acceptance: Server recalculates totals; client amount is never authoritative.

Module: Legacy Charter / Flight Share Scope Gate
Responsibility: Preserve existing JETPOOL charter-sharing brand IA as content/lead/request flow; transactional air-charter booking remains disabled until business/legal scope is approved.
Acceptance: Existing brand/content is migrated; direct booking/payment flag remains OFF until an explicit release ADR and compliance approval.

Responsibility: PG adapter, prepare/confirm, server-side amount check, webhook reconciliation and payment state.
Acceptance: Success redirect alone never confirms a transaction; server confirmation and idempotent webhook reconciliation do.

Responsibility: Full/partial refund intents, provider execution, retries, reconciliation and audit.
Acceptance: Refund amount cannot exceed refundable balance; duplicate provider callbacks are harmless.

Responsibility: Immutable financial transaction journal for gross, fee, refund, tax adjustment, payable and payout.
Acceptance: Every posted transaction balances debit/credit per currency; corrections are compensating entries, not edits.

Responsibility: Settlement periods, payee statement, approval, payout execution/reconciliation and holds.
Acceptance: Settlement net derives from ledger; payout account changes require AAL2 and audit.

Responsibility: Configurable fee and tax evidence rules by merchant/supplier type; no unverified hard-coded universal tax rate.
Acceptance: Rules are effective-dated/versioned and changes do not retroactively mutate historical transactions.

Responsibility: Context-bound conversation, message persistence, realtime delivery, attachments, read state and abuse controls.
Acceptance: RLS/API policy prevents non-members from reading/subscribing; admin access requires case-based audited elevation.

Responsibility: Email/SMS/push/in-app preferences, templates, retries and event-driven delivery.
Acceptance: Critical booking/payment notices ignore marketing opt-out but honor mandatory-channel policy and delivery audit.

Responsibility: Chatwoot-backed support intake linked to user/booking/exchange/dispute context.
Acceptance: Support agent access is scoped and sensitive data is masked unless elevation is granted.

Responsibility: Operational console for users, listings, compliance, reservations, exchanges, guides, payments, refunds and settlements.
Acceptance: Every money/permission/compliance mutation is AAL2-gated and append-only audited.

Responsibility: Destination/story/FAQ/promotion/legacy WONT content, redirects, metadata and structured content.
Acceptance: Legacy high-value URLs have 301 mappings and content publication is separated from transaction truth.

Responsibility: GMV, conversion, cancellation, search, compliance, disputes, finance dashboards and immutable audit trail.
Acceptance: Operational metrics reconcile against source tables; audit logs exclude secrets while retaining actor/resource/effect.

Responsibility: Project PostgreSQL entities into Meilisearch; reindex, version, lag monitoring and recovery.
Acceptance: Index can be rebuilt from PostgreSQL and never acts as final authority for sellable availability.

Responsibility: MapLibre rendering support, geocoding abstraction, viewport search and provider cost controls.
Acceptance: Provider is replaceable behind adapter; address precision exposure follows privacy policy.

Responsibility: Outbox in same transaction, durable queue, retries, dead-letter handling, event correlation and schema version.
Acceptance: No domain mutation emits only an in-memory event; retries are idempotent and observable.

Responsibility: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, logs, synthetic checks, SLOs, alerting and incident runbooks.
Acceptance: Dashboards cover p95 latency, error rate, queue lag, payment reconciliation lag and booking collision errors.

Responsibility: WAF/rate-limit, bot protection, secret management, SAST/SCA/SBOM, DAST, upload scanning and risk flags.
Acceptance: Release blocks on critical vulnerabilities, leaked secrets, failed permission-negative tests or missing SBOM.

Responsibility: Environment-safe feature flags, business rules, percentage rollout and kill switches.
Acceptance: Critical features such as paid charter flow can remain OFF independently of deployment.

Responsibility: Inventory existing URLs/content/member/order assets, official export, ID mapping, media import, consent audit, 301s and cutover reconciliation.
Acceptance: Dry-run reconciliation proves row counts, amounts, media references and URL mappings before cutover.

Responsibility: Intent parsing, trip planning, explainable suggestions using live search/availability; never autonomously commits paid transactions.
Acceptance: AI suggestions cite live availability snapshot and require explicit user confirmation before hold/payment.

Responsibility: Behavioral/explicit preference ranking with cold-start rules, opt-out and non-authoritative recommendations.
Acceptance: Opt-out removes behavioral personalization; ranking never bypasses legal/compliance/availability filters.

Responsibility: External PMS/channel/supplier adapter framework, polling/webhooks, mapping and conflict handling.
Acceptance: External state is reconciled into Jetpool authority rules with clear conflict policy and audit.
